notes: Tariq Al-Khwarizmi is a Phase-0 alumnus conferred before the Council protocol existed, and this review is retroactive. For a retroactive review of an already-conferred alumnus, this passes the threshold (overall 7.73, no veto triggers), but future candidates in this domain would be expected to present a broader corpus.
